# awscc_cases_related_item (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Cases::RelatedItem. Creates a related item (comments) and associates it with a case.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `case_id` (String) A unique identifier of the case.
- `content` (Attributes) The content of a related item to be created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content))
- `domain_id` (String) The unique identifier of the Cases domain.
- `type` (String) The type of a related item.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of tags on the related item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `related_item_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the related item.
- `related_item_id` (String) The unique identifier of the related item.

<a id="nestedatt--content"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content`

Optional:

- `comment` (Attributes) Represents a comment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--content--comment))

<a id="nestedatt--content--comment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `content.comment`

Optional:

- `body` (String) Text in the body of a comment.
- `content_type` (String) Type of the text in the comment.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cases_related_item.example
  identity = {
    related_item_arn = "related_item_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `related_item_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the related item

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cases_related_item.example
  id = "related_item_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_cases_related_item.example "related_item_arn"
```
